column1: # source<TAB>translation.  \n represents a runtime line break; ASCII punctuation is retained.

-Armor Up-
Subtracts 1 damage from all
recieved standard attacks.
column2: -护甲提升-\n所有普通攻击造成的伤害\n减少1点.

column1:
-Attack Speed Plus-
Increases the speed of
all standard attacks by
12%.
column2: -攻击速度提升-\n所有普通攻击的速度\n提高12%.

column1: -Axis of Fury-\nRelentless arm swinging.\n6 hits dealing 4 damage each.
column2: -狂怒回旋-\n无情挥舞手臂.\n连续6击,每击造成4点伤害.

column1: -Blaster-\nBlasts a ball of energy \ndealing 5 Damage.
column2: -能量炮-\n发射一枚能量球,\n造成5点伤害.

column1:
-Clone-
Summon a clone that will
fight by your side for 10
seconds.
column2: -分身-\n召唤一个分身,\n与你并肩战斗10秒.

column1: -Damage Up-\nIncreases the damage of all\nstandard attacks by 1.
column2: -伤害提升-\n所有普通攻击的伤害\n提高1点.

column1:
-Drill Dash-
An aim-able dash attack that 
digs through ground. Can deal 
4 hits of 2 damage.
column2:
-钻头冲刺-
可瞄准的冲刺攻击,
能钻穿地面并连续4击,
每击造成2点伤害.

column1:
-Giganto Missile-
Fires a large homing missile that
explodes on impact dealing 15
damage to anyone.
column2:
-巨型导弹-
发射大型追踪导弹,
命中爆炸,对任何目标
造成15点伤害.

column1:
-Launch-
Launches you upwards into
controllable flight dealing 8
damage. Can also be aimed down.
column2:
-弹射-
将你向上弹射进入
可控制的飞行,造成8点
伤害.也可向下瞄准.

column1: -Megabyte Punch-\nA devastating shield-breaking\npunch dealing 25 damage.
column2: -兆字节重击-\n毁灭性的破盾拳击,\n造成25点伤害.

column1: -Minigun-\nFires 20 instant shots dealing\n2 damage each.
column2: -迷你机枪-\n瞬间连续射出20发子弹,\n每发造成2点伤害.

column1: -Missile-\nA homing projectile that\nexplodes to deal 10 damage.
column2: -导弹-\n发射一枚追踪弹,\n爆炸造成10点伤害.

column1:
-Movement Speed Up-
Increases all movement speed 
by 10% and slightly increases 
jump height.
column2: -移动速度提升-\n所有移动速度提高10%,\n并略微增加跳跃高度.

column1:
-Pelvic Thrust-
A difficult to hit thrust that 
instantly pierces shields and 
does 20 damage.
column2:
-破盾突袭-
难以命中的突刺,
可立即贯穿护盾,
造成20点伤害.

column1: -Place Mine-\nPlaces a timer-based mine dealing\n20 damage to anyone.
column2: -布设地雷-\n布置定时地雷,\n对任何目标造成20点伤害.

column1:
-Place Virus Mine-
Places a virus mine that hits 
for 5 damage and infects for 8 
seconds, dealing 36 damage.
column2:
-布设病毒地雷-
布置病毒地雷,命中造成
5点伤害并感染8秒,
总计造成36点伤害.

column1: -Place Wall-\nCreates a wall of 3 blocks high.
column2: -布设墙体-\n建造一面高3格的墙.

column1: -Plus Jump-\nGrants 1 extra jump.\n(Base is 2)
column2: -额外跳跃-\n获得1次额外跳跃.\n(基础次数为2)

column1: -Pound-\nA downwards pound that \ndeals 15 damage.
column2: -重击-\n向下猛砸,\n造成15点伤害.

column1: -Rapid Fire-\nFires 8 instant shots dealing\n2 damage each.
column2: -快速射击-\n瞬间连续射出8发子弹,\n每发造成2点伤害.

column1: -Red Virus Immunity-\nGrants immunity to red virus \nclouds.
column2: -红病毒免疫-\n免疫红病毒云.

column1:
-Shield Life Up-
Increases shield life to
withstand 4 more damage.
(Base is 4)
column2: -护盾生命提升-\n护盾可额外承受4点伤害.\n(基础值为4)

column1: -Slice Dash-\nA horizontal dash dealing 8\ndamage with downward knockback.
column2: -斩击冲刺-\n水平冲刺斩击,\n造成8点伤害并向下击退.

column1: -Slice-\nA melee attack with a decent\nrange. Deals 12 damage.
column2: -斩击-\n中等攻击范围的近战攻击.\n造成12点伤害.

column1: -Snipe Shot-\nA single shot dealing 8 \ndamage and knockback.
column2: -狙击弹-\n发射一枚子弹,\n造成8点伤害并击退目标.

column1:
-Spinkick-
A melee attack with strong
horizontal knockback that deals
18 damage.
column2:
-旋踢-
近战攻击,拥有强力的
水平击退效果,
造成18点伤害.

column1:
-Summon Guard-
Summon a crab guard that 
will that will defend you
for 30 seconds.
column2: -召唤守卫-\n召唤一个螃蟹守卫,\n守护你30秒.

column1: -Summon Kachooks-\nSummon 4 kachooks that will\ndance and explode on death.
column2: -召唤Kachooks-\n召唤4只Kachooks,\n它们会跳舞并在死亡时爆炸.

column1:
-Summon Soldier-
Summon a soldier that will
fight by your side for 30
seconds.
column2: -召唤士兵-\n召唤一名士兵,\n与你并肩战斗30秒.

column1: -Swoop-\nA fast, controllable flight.
column2: -俯冲-\n快速、可控制的飞行.

column1:
-T Attack-
A simultaneous punch and kick
that deals 15 damage on both
sides.
column2: -T形攻击-\n同时出拳和踢击,\n两侧各造成15点伤害.

column1:
-Teleport-
Instantly displaces you in a
desired direction and releases
a static charge dealing 12 damage.
column2:
-传送-
立即向指定方向位移,
并释放静电,
造成12点伤害.

column1:
-Tornado-
A controllable spinning attack. 
Can hit 8 times with 3 damage 
per hit.
column2:
-龙卷-
可控制的旋转攻击.
可连续命中8次,
每击造成3点伤害.

column1: -Uppercut-\nSmacks opponents upwards\ndealing 16 damage.
column2: -上勾拳-\n将对手向上击飞,\n造成16点伤害.

column1: -Virus Slice-\nSlices for 4 damage plus 16 \ndamage over 4 seconds.
column2: -病毒斩-\n斩击造成4点伤害,\n并在4秒内额外造成16点伤害.

column1:
-Shovel-
Digs through breakable blocks,
does 1 damage and launches high
upwards.
column2:
-铲击-
挖穿可破坏方块,
造成1点伤害并将你
高高发射.
